End the [[Jade Brotherhood]] threat by taking out their leader.

==Quest information==

===Objectives===
* Find [[Quufu]] and kill him.
* See [[Guardsman Tang]] for your reward

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 250 [[Gold]]
* [[Imperial Commendation]]

==Walkthrough==
Starting from [[The Marketplace]] follow along the northern edge until you reach the bridge closest to the northwestern end. Getting to [[Quufu]] will be difficult; the small island has a number of enemies and a large group of them constantly patrols around it. Pulling one group of enemies will spawn another which may end up pulling another nearby group, leading to you quickly being swarmed and wiped. Quufu will initially be alone, but if you step in the immediate vicinity of the asterisk on your minimap, a mob will spawn with him. You can pull Quufu away using ranged attacks, and [[aggro]] him separately, preventing the additional spawns. Killing him ends the quest.

==Dialogue==

===Initial dialogue===
'''Guardsman Tang'''
:''"You were good enough to lend us your assistance earlier, <character name>, and now I must ask for your help once again. A group of affluent youths are taking advantage of the chaos in Kaineng City to victimize helpless citizens and refugees. They call themselves the '''[[Jade Brotherhood]]''', and they have bought off a number of ministry officials to avoid prosecution.''

:''"If you were to take out their leader, perhaps their games would end. Their base is in a secluded area to the '''north''', and their leader, '''[[Quufu]]''', can almost always be found there. Will you lend us your aid once more and dispatch this scoundrel?"''
{{offer dialog
|accept = Quufu won't last the night.
|decline = I'm sure he's not all that bad.
|ask = Are you having second thoughts? Let me assure you, '''Quufu''' is a crook and a murderer, and the citizens of Kaineng City will be safer with him and his gang off the streets. 
|indent = :: }}

===Reward dialogue===
'''Guardsman Tang'''
:''"With Quufu out of the picture, it is likely that the Jade Brotherhood will fall apart. We are grateful, once again, for your assistance."''

==Notes==
* Though [[Quufu]] has a feminine appearance, he is referred to with male pronouns.
